name: texconv
description: Microsoft DirectXTex texture converter: resize, block-compress (BC1-BC7), and generate mipmaps for DDS/TGA/PNG textures from the command line

texconv.description: DDS texture converter and downscaler with BC block-compression and mipmap generation, scriptable for batch texture optimization
texconv.usage:
texconv -w 2048 -h 2048 -f DXT1 -m 0 -y -o outdir in.dds # Downscale to 2048 as BC1 with full mip chain
texconv -f DXT5 -m 0 -y -o outdir normal.dds # Re-encode as BC3 with mips
texconv -info in.dds # Print format and dimensions
texconv -r -w 2048 -h 2048 -y -o outdir dir\*.dds # Batch a directory recursively
